Hi, could you send me a copy of our February statement for our accountant?

Hannah Okafor
Northwind Bakery

Hi Hannah, the February statement is in your billing portal under Documents. Let us know if you need anything else!

Tom

Hello,

Our Visa ending 1881 was charged $480.00 twice yesterday (March 10) for wholesale order #1077. We only placed the order once. Please refund the extra charge.

Thanks,
Hannah Okafor
Northwind Bakery
Customer says order #1077 was captured twice. Needs someone with Stripe access to check and refund the second capture.

We were billed $480.00 for the March equipment lease. Can you confirm that's the right amount?

Derek Lund
Northwind Traders

Can order #1080 be delivered before 7am on Thursday?

Hannah
Hi Hannah, checking with dispatch and will confirm shortly.
